title: New Game Plus Walkthrough

blocks.text: This checklist is for the New Game Plus playthrough to complete the game. There will be a complete walkthrough added in a later version of the guide. Required tasks are needed for the Golden Completed Trophy. Optional tasks are extra content you can view in a second playthrough, but isn't required for the Golden Competed Trophy.

items.text: Obtain Big Bro is Worried Trophy (Visit Nanako in the hospital 3 times)
Obtain Hardcore Risette Fan Trophy (Hear 250 of Rise's navigation lines)
See alternate school club Social Links
See alternate female Social Link routes (alternate Sun requires multiple playthroughs or Save Abuse)
